_comment: The Netlify schedule fires every 10 minutes all year. The function fetches only from poll_start through poll_end, Israel local time, and only while poll is true. Set poll to false to stop early. auto false notices a newer file and does not deploy it. K26_AUTO=0 on Netlify stops dispatch even when auto is true. K26_AUTO=1 allows dispatch even when auto is false. K26_POLL=0 stops fetching even inside the window. Turnout (pre-results, election day): turnout_poll/turnout_poll_start/turnout_poll_end gate k26-turnout-poll the same way over the daytime window; turnout_auto is its chicken bit (K26_TURNOUT_AUTO / K26_TURNOUT_POLL env overrides; feed URL is K26_TURNOUT_URL). nowcast_model: which transfer model the count centre opens with for every visitor -- 'abs' = with non-voters (default), 'plain' = without non-voters. Both are always computed; visitors can still flip locally. Takes effect at the next data refresh after the change is pushed.
